viewer_sees: A king in white and indigo rides in through a gate of Mamluk Cairo; in the market inside, merchants hold up gold in both hands
Mansa Musa rides at the head of a caravan across the dunes toward Mecca, camels behind him
ANIMATED MAP: West Africa at the left, the Mediterranean at the upper right; gold routes and salt routes draw themselves across the Sahara
A camp of cotton tents beside the pyramids, caravan smoke rising, camels kneeling, the Nile a green strip far off
The sultan’s emir rides out with a small guard to meet the Mali caravan at the edge of the camp
Later, the emir tells al-Umari what he saw while the historian writes
Musa answers through an interpreter who stands between him and the emir
Camels laden with leather sacks of raw gold pass through the citadel gate, one sack spilling nuggets and dust
The emir urges Musa toward the citadel at the right; Musa shakes his head and refuses
Rows of courtiers kiss the marble floor before the throne; the camera pushes toward the throne
Musa enters the hall; chamberlains point down at the floor
Musa frowns at the floor; the interpreter leans in and whispers in his ear
Musa bows to God, forehead to the floor; the sultan half rises and gestures to a seat at his side
Musa pours gold into the open hands of a crowd in a Cairo street
A row of emirs and officials each receive a sack of gold hoisted onto mules by Mali servants
Cairo merchants and Mali men bargain and smile in a vaulted bazaar
A money-changer pours gold dust into a balance while the price tilts down
Al-Umari at his desk with a balance: one gold mithqal on a pan and exactly twenty-five silver dirhams in five stacks of five
The same balance after: one gold mithqal against exactly twenty-two silver dirhams, a scratched line showing where twenty-five stood
A long empty reading hall with only al-Umari at one table under one lamp
Al-Maqrizi writes at his desk beside a gold dinar and six silver dirhams
A modern historian bends over photocopied ledgers and a wavering hand-drawn line chart
Musa alone in close-up, tired, at dusk
The pilgrim caravan struggles through a cold desert pass; baggage left behind, riders watching from a ridge
Musa humbled before Cairo merchants with a ledger, a Mali man selling a bolt of cloth
A merchant at his counting table watches the caravan leave at the far end of the street, an empty strongbox open
A mapmaker in Majorca paints a crowned king holding a gold nugget onto a vellum map
Macro of the atlas panel: the crowned king, the gold nugget and the Catalan caption, gold leaf catching the light
A world map: gold glow floods the whole map, then shrinks to the Sahel patch
A money-changer’s balance with gold on one pan and silver on the other, the pans swaying slowly and never settling
Al-Umari arrives in Cairo, then stands in a bazaar crowd where Cairenes eagerly tell him about the king
Gold dust blows from an open bag across the dunes as Mansa Musa rides toward the horizon
End card: poster of the whole story with the title, Musa, the sultan and the SUBSCRIBE button
